user_story: As a planner, I want tasks grouped into Scope/Todo/In Progress/Done/Backlog, so that I see workflow state at a glance.
expected_behaviour: 5 columns render in fixed order with dot color, label, live count, add button; tasks grouped by status; static set so no 'no columns' case.

user_story: As a user, I want a helpful message when a column has no tasks, so that empty columns aren't confusing.
expected_behaviour: Each status shows bespoke empty copy in a dashed placeholder; but the inline Add-task button only renders for non-empty columns (empty column shows only the header +).

user_story: As a user, I want feedback while the board loads, so that I know it's working.
expected_behaviour: Real user expects a skeleton of the columns; today the whole board is blocked on a single bare 'Loading board…' text until both project+tasks queries resolve.
error_detail: Whole board blocks on bare "Loading board…" text; no column skeleton

user_story: As a user, I want to know when the board fails to load, so that I'm not staring at a blank screen.
expected_behaviour: Error should be human and recoverable; today it renders role=alert with raw error.message and no retry; project undefined → 'Project not found.'
error_detail: Load error shows raw error.message with no retry action

user_story: As a planner, I want to add a task to a specific column, so that I capture work in the right state.
expected_behaviour: Header + and bottom Add-task both open the create dialog pre-seeded to that column.

user_story: As a planner, I want to name a task and set status+lane, so that it lands on the board correctly.
expected_behaviour: Dialog with label/status/lane; create disabled while empty/creating; success toast+close; a real user needs an error message if create fails and jargon-free lane help — today create has no onError (silent fail) and lane copy is factory jargon.
error_detail: Create-task has no onError; on failure dialog silently re-enables
fix_summary: Global MutationCache onError fallback toast surfaces the failure (skips mutations that own onError)

user_story: As a user, I want to click a card to see details, so that I can read/edit it.
expected_behaviour: Card click opens a right sheet; 6px move tolerance disambiguates drag vs click; also via card … → Open.

user_story: As a planner, I want to drag a card to another column, so that I change status by moving it.
expected_behaviour: Pointer/keyboard drag patches status with optimistic update to tasks+canvas, success toast, rollback on error; same-column drop is a no-op; rollback is silent (no error toast).

user_story: As a user, I want to click a status chip and pick a new status, so that I restage without dragging.
expected_behaviour: Chip dropdown lists all 5 statuses and patches on select; a real user expects the same instant feedback+failure signal as drag, but this path has no optimistic update and is silent on failure (inconsistent with drag).
error_detail: Status-chip change is non-optimistic and silent on failure (inconsistent with drag)
fix_summary: Global MutationCache onError fallback toast surfaces the failure (skips mutations that own onError)

user_story: As a user, I want per-card actions, so that I manage a task without opening it.
expected_behaviour: Open / Move-to / Delete should be reachable by everyone; today the … trigger is hover-only (opacity-0 → group-hover) so it is invisible on touch and to keyboard users.
error_detail: Card … actions are hover-only (opacity-0→group-hover); invisible on touch/keyboard

user_story: As a user, I want deletion to require confirmation, so that I don't lose work accidentally.
expected_behaviour: … → Delete opens a confirm dialog (cannot be undone), success toast, closes drawer if open; needs an error message on failure — today no onError so the dialog just re-enables silently.
error_detail: Delete has no onError; confirm dialog silently re-enables on failure
fix_summary: Global MutationCache onError fallback toast surfaces the failure (skips mutations that own onError)

user_story: As a user, I want to read a task's full detail, so that I understand it before acting.
expected_behaviour: Read mode: status menu, shortId, share, definition list (status/lane/linked doc), read-only rich description, tag chips; linked-doc link navigates and closes drawer.

user_story: As a user, I want to edit label/description/tags, so that I refine a task in place.
expected_behaviour: Edit toggle → editor; description re-serialized only if dirty (lossy-guard); label patched only if changed+non-empty; needs a save-failure message — today save has no error surface.
error_detail: Drawer save has no error surface
fix_summary: Global MutationCache onError fallback toast surfaces the failure (skips mutations that own onError)

user_story: As a user, I want to tag tasks, so that I categorize and filter them.
expected_behaviour: Datalist-suggested add + per-chip remove; server uses full-set replace; needs failure feedback — today silent on failure.
error_detail: Tag add/remove silent on failure
fix_summary: Global MutationCache onError fallback toast surfaces the failure (skips mutations that own onError)

user_story: As a planner, I want to filter the board by tag, so that I focus on a subset.
expected_behaviour: Bar renders only when project has tags; toggle buttons (aria-pressed) with OR semantics, Clear-filter when active; client-side over loaded tasks.

user_story: As a user, I want to see which tasks have a spec doc, so that I jump to context.
expected_behaviour: FileText icon (aria-labeled) on cards whose id is a document linked_task; drawer shows a clickable linked-doc row.

user_story: As a supervisor, I want to see a task's factory lane, so that I know its review gate.
expected_behaviour: Lane derived from a lane: tag shown uppercase on card+drawer; a real user needs an in-drawer lane editor and plain-language meaning — today it is set only at create and the auto/approve/full labels are unexplained jargon.
error_detail: Lane labels auto/approve/full are unexplained jargon; no in-drawer editor

user_story: As a user, I want a compact id on each card, so that I can reference the task.
expected_behaviour: Last 4 chars of the UUID uppercased in mono; a real user cannot tell what it means or that it may not be unique — needs a tooltip/label.
error_detail: shortId (4 UUID chars) has no label/tooltip; meaning+uniqueness unclear

user_story: As a planner, I want the flow route to show the canvas beside an agent-activity rail, so that I see structure and agent work together.
expected_behaviour: Loading 'Loading project…'; error alert; 'Project not found.'; success renders FlowCanvas + 300px agents panel; no role gating (anyone who loads can edit).

user_story: As a planner, I want tasks and edges drawn as a node graph, so that I see the plan spatially.
expected_behaviour: Load/error/not-found states present; ReactFlow with dotted bg + fitView; BUT a project with zero tasks shows only the dot grid with no 'add your first task' guidance.
error_detail: Empty canvas shows only a dot grid, no add-first-task guidance

user_story: As a planner, I want to type a name and add a task, so that a new node appears.
expected_behaviour: Top-left form; empty blocked; new task placed at viewport center; a real user needs the new node to be visible and a failure message — today create has no onError and the node can land off-screen depending on pan/zoom.
error_detail: Add-task has no onError; new node can land off-screen
fix_summary: Global MutationCache onError fallback toast surfaces the failure (skips mutations that own onError)

user_story: As a planner, I want to click a node title to rename, so that I relabel quickly.
expected_behaviour: Click title → input; Enter/blur commits, Escape reverts; empty/unchanged reverts; needs a failure signal — today patch has no error state.
error_detail: Inline rename patch silent on failure
fix_summary: Global MutationCache onError fallback toast surfaces the failure (skips mutations that own onError)

user_story: As a planner, I want to change status from a node, so that the board reflects progress.
expected_behaviour: StatusMenu chip optimistically updates + patches; needs failure feedback — silent on error.
error_detail: Node status change silent on failure
fix_summary: Global MutationCache onError fallback toast surfaces the failure (skips mutations that own onError)

user_story: As a planner, I want to delete a task from its node, so that I can prune the plan.
expected_behaviour: X → confirm('Delete this task? Connected edges will be removed.'); confirmed destructive; needs a failure signal — delete has no error state.
error_detail: Node delete silent on failure
fix_summary: Global MutationCache onError fallback toast surfaces the failure (skips mutations that own onError)

user_story: As a planner, I want a Doc link on tasks with a spec, so that I jump to it.
expected_behaviour: Link appears only when a linked doc resolves; routes to the doc; tasks with no doc show nothing and offer no way to create/link a doc from the canvas.

user_story: As a planner, I want to drag node→node to declare a dependency, so that I build the graph visually.
expected_behaviour: Drag between handles adds an edge and saves; but every hand-drawn edge is hard-coded 'depends_on' with no UI to choose/edit the label; handles are a hidden affordance; no per-edge error surface.
error_detail: Hand-drawn edges hard-coded depends_on; no UI to choose/edit label

user_story: As a planner, I want each edge to show its relationship, so that I understand the dependency.
expected_behaviour: LabeledEdge shows a pill label; a real user needs to set/change it (blocks/feeds/enables) but the UI is read-only and the vocabulary is snake_case jargon.
error_detail: Edge label read-only; richer labels unreachable; snake_case jargon

user_story: As a planner, I want to delete a dependency edge, so that I correct the graph.
expected_behaviour: Select edge → top 'Delete edge' button or Delete/Backspace (suppressed in inputs) → confirm; confirmed destructive; selection cleared.

user_story: As a planner, I want to drag nodes and have positions saved, so that my arrangement sticks.
expected_behaviour: Drag → 400ms-debounced putCanvas persists positions+edges; 'Saving…' pill + 'Save failed' alert on error (good).

user_story: As a planner, I want a one-click tidy layout, so that a messy graph becomes readable.
expected_behaviour: Dagre layout + grid-pack isolated nodes + fitView, saved immediately; but it overwrites all manual positions with no confirm and no undo.
error_detail: Auto-layout overwrites all manual positions, no confirm, no undo
fix_summary: Auto-layout now behind a ConfirmDialog (warns manual arrangement is replaced)

user_story: As a planner, I want zoom and fit controls, so that I navigate large graphs.
expected_behaviour: Bottom-left zoom-in/out/fit buttons + standard pan/scroll.

user_story: As a planner, I want clicking a node to open a detail panel, so that I edit full fields.
expected_behaviour: Selection opens right TaskDetail (status/assignee/due/doc/description/comments); Edit toggle; Save disabled while saving; close deselects.

user_story: As a planner, I want to edit label/assignee/due/description, so that the spec is complete.
expected_behaviour: Edit exposes fields + rich description (re-serialized only if dirty, lossless otherwise); needs a save-failure signal — no error state.
error_detail: Detail edit save silent on failure
fix_summary: Global MutationCache onError fallback toast surfaces the failure (skips mutations that own onError)

user_story: As a planner, I want to tag tasks on the canvas, so that I categorize them anywhere.
expected_behaviour: TaskDetail supports tags but FlowCanvas doesn't pass the tag handlers, so the entire Tags section is absent on the canvas — a feature that exists but is unreachable here.
error_detail: Task tags exist in TaskDetail but unreachable on canvas (handlers not passed)

user_story: As a planner, I want to comment on a task or a highlighted passage, so that I leave feedback.
expected_behaviour: CommentsPanel embedded in detail; selecting a passage stages it for the next comment.

user_story: As a planner, I want to see recent agent runs and events, so that I know what automation did.
expected_behaviour: Runs newest-first with status badge, relative time, event messages; loading/error/empty all covered; read-only.

user_story: As a planner, I want Delete/Backspace to remove what I selected, so that editing is fast.
expected_behaviour: Delete removes selected EDGES only (with confirm, suppressed in inputs); selected NODES are not keyboard-deletable (inconsistent) and the container must be focused for it to work.
error_detail: Delete key removes edges only not nodes (inconsistent); needs container focus

user_story: As a project member, I want the documents area to load reliably, so that I trust what I see.
expected_behaviour: Project load/error/not-found gated; BUT docs/folders/tasks default to [] with their own loading/error NOT surfaced — a failed docs query looks like an empty panel.
error_detail: Docs/folders default to [] with loading/error unsurfaced; failed query looks empty
fix_summary: Surfaced docs/folders query error instead of an empty panel

user_story: As a user, I want to jump to any folder-path level, so that I don't get lost.

user_story: As a returning user, I want the 4 most-recent docs, so that I resume what changed.
expected_behaviour: Shown at root when ≥1 doc, sorted by updated_at; cards show title+status.

user_story: As an organizer, I want to add a folder, so that I group docs.

error_detail: Create folder silent on failure

user_story: As a user, I want to create a doc optionally linked to a task, so that specs tie to work.

fix_summary: Global MutationCache onError fallback toast surfaces the failure (skips mutations that own onError)

user_story: As a reader, I want to click a doc to open it, so that I read/edit.

user_story: As a browser, I want each folder's contents at a glance, so that I decide where to go.

user_story: As an organizer, I want to rename a folder, so that names stay accurate.

fix_summary: Global MutationCache onError fallback toast surfaces the failure (skips mutations that own onError)

error_detail: Delete folder silent on failure
fix_summary: Global MutationCache onError fallback toast surfaces the failure (skips mutations that own onError)

user_story: As a user, I want to delete a doc with a warning, so that I don't lose work.

error_detail: Delete doc silent on failure
fix_summary: Global MutationCache onError fallback toast surfaces the failure (skips mutations that own onError)

user_story: As a first-time user, I want guidance when there's nothing, so that I know what to do.
expected_behaviour: Root/folder/level-specific empty messages present.

user_story: As a scanner, I want status + linked-task at a glance, so that I gauge state fast.
expected_behaviour: Status line + linked-task chip; both hidden below sm/md breakpoints and chip vanishes if tasks not yet loaded.

user_story: As a reader, I want to read cleanly then switch to edit, so that reading isn't cluttered.

expected_behaviour: ~1s debounce, 5s maxWait, ⌘S flush, unmount + beforeunload flush; SaveStatusIndicator shows Unsaved→Saving→Saved (+error); route 'Save failed' banner; ⌘S and exit-flush are invisible affordances.

user_story: As a writer, I want inline title + status line, so that metadata stays in the doc.
expected_behaviour: Borderless title + Status field feed autosave; empty status saved null.

user_story: As a writer, I want quick formatting buttons, so that I style without markdown.
expected_behaviour: Bold/Italic/H2/List/Table/Image with aria-pressed; toolbar uses hardcoded hex, ignoring theme tokens/dark mode.
error_detail: Formatting toolbar hardcoded hex; ignores theme tokens/dark mode

user_story: As a Notion-familiar writer, I want a / menu to insert blocks, so that I stay on the keyboard.
expected_behaviour: / opens a filterable block menu with keyboard nav + 'No results'; but nothing on screen hints that / exists — pure tacit discovery.

user_story: As a reviewer, I want to highlight text and comment on that passage, so that feedback is anchored.
expected_behaviour: Select text → floating 'Add comment' → anchored composer; ⌘Enter submits; success toast.

user_story: As a collaborator, I want an open/resolved comments panel, so that I track feedback with a teammate/agent.
expected_behaviour: Loading/error/empty states; rich composer + attach-selection; per-comment resolve/reopen/delete (confirm); show-resolved collapsible.

expected_behaviour: Loading/error/not-found gated, then FileIssue + InboxPanel + AgentRuns.

expected_behaviour: Expandable form (title req, desc, severity) creates a backlog task; success clears+collapses+toast; error alert; heading and button both say 'File an issue' (duplicate).

user_story: As an owner, I want to see all pending client submissions, so that I act on incoming feedback.
expected_behaviour: Count badge; loading/error/empty ('no share configured or nothing new'); rows show title/severity/participant/excerpt.

user_story: As an owner, I want to fold a duplicate into an existing task, so that I avoid duplicate work.
expected_behaviour: Requires typing a raw task id into a free-text field (no picker/search) then Merge; success toast — opaque id entry.

user_story: As an owner, I want to discuss a submission inline, so that triage context is captured.
expected_behaviour: Toggle embedded CommentsPanel; label shows open-comment count.

user_story: As an owner, I want to release a backlog task to scope, so that it enters design/sizing.
expected_behaviour: Backlog list w/ loading/error/empty; 'Release to scope' patches status; success toast — 'Release to scope' is factory jargon.
error_detail: "Release to scope" is factory jargon

user_story: As an owner, I want to see Curator-proposed scope tasks, so that I know what AI suggested.

user_story: As an external guest, I want a share link to resolve my session, so that I reach the right screen.

expected_behaviour: Fetches meta (loading); heading=audience; copy adapts invite vs public; email required+hint in invite mode; 'Joining…'; clear for a layperson.

user_story: As a guest, I want to read shared spec docs, so that I get context.

expected_behaviour: project name + view label; while project loads the name renders empty (no placeholder).
error_detail: Breadcrumb project name renders empty while loading (no placeholder)

user_story: As a user, I want a keyboard palette, so that I act without the mouse.
expected_behaviour: ⌘K opens globally; filter; 'No results found.'

user_story: As a user, I want to jump between project views, so that I move fast.
expected_behaviour: Navigate group lists views but OMITS Documents (sidebar has it) — an inconsistency.
error_detail: Command-menu Navigate omits Documents though sidebar lists it

user_story: As a user, I want to switch projects/settings from the palette, so that I don't hunt.
expected_behaviour: All-projects + each project + Members/MCP; no loading/empty affordance inside the palette.

user_story: As a member/admin/owner, I want to see my active org + role, so that I know my context.
expected_behaviour: Switcher when >1 org (current disabled+✓); plain text when 1; role badge display-only; nothing when no session.

user_story: As a multi-org user, I want to switch active org, so that I work in the right one.
expected_behaviour: setActiveOrganization then invalidate all queries; current/pending disabled; on failure NO error surfaced (silent).
error_detail: Org-switch failure not surfaced
fix_summary: Global MutationCache onError fallback toast surfaces the failure (skips mutations that own onError)

user_story: As a browser-session user, I want to sign out, so that I end my session.
expected_behaviour: 'Sign out' only when kind==='session'; success clears cookie + invalidates; on failure NO error surfaced.
error_detail: Logout failure not surfaced
fix_summary: Global MutationCache onError fallback toast surfaces the failure (skips mutations that own onError)

user_story: As a signed-out visitor, I want to sign in with GitHub, so that I reach my workspace.
expected_behaviour: Branded card; 'Continue with GitHub'→'Redirecting…'; reassurance line; on start-failure inline error; BUT if useAuthMethods fetch fails (retry:false) the card shows only a heading with no CTA and no error.
error_detail: If useAuthMethods fetch fails the card shows only a heading — no CTA, no error

user_story: As a visitor on a non-GitHub instance, I want authentication guidance, so that I can still connect.
expected_behaviour: Shows instructions to mint a token + use plandesk connect; no in-UI token entry; heavy CLI jargon for a first-timer.
error_detail: Token fallback is heavy CLI jargon; no in-UI token entry

user_story: As an invited teammate, I want to see which org/role I'm joining, so that I trust the link.
expected_behaviour: Rootless page previews 'Join {org} as {role}'; loading + not-found + already-used states present (good).

user_story: As an invited teammate, I want to sign in and accept, so that I join the org.
expected_behaviour: Signed-out→GitHub returning to /invite/:id; signed-in→Accept→reload to /; error states 410/403/401 mapped; wrong-account (403) only surfaces at accept-time, not preview.

user_story: As a signed-in user, I want to move between Members and MCP, so that I find both.
expected_behaviour: Both routes show Members ↔ MCP/CLI-token nav with active state; no /settings index/redirect.

user_story: As an owner, I want to mint an org-wide CLI token, so that plandesk login works.
expected_behaviour: 'Generate CLI token'→'Generating…'; success reveals one-time token + login instructions; error alert 'may need owner access' (good).

user_story: As an owner, I want to copy the token, so that I paste it into the CLI.
expected_behaviour: Copy writes to clipboard, flips to 'Copied'; clipboard rejection is unhandled (silent) and 'Copied' never reverts.
error_detail: Copy token: clipboard rejection unhandled; "Copied" never resets
fix_summary: Clipboard write try/catch + error toast + 'Copied' resets after 1.5s

user_story: As an owner/agent operator, I want MCP connection guidance, so that I wire an agent.
expected_behaviour: Route titled 'MCP Settings' with a subtitle promising agent connection, but the body is ONLY the CLI-token card — there is no MCP config/copy block; the promised feature effectively doesn't exist.
error_detail: MCP Settings promises agent/MCP setup but body is only the CLI-token card; no MCP config
fix_summary: Added 'Connect an agent (MCP)' card with copyable login/connect commands + docs link

user_story: As an owner/admin/member, I want to see the roster, so that I know who belongs.
expected_behaviour: Session loading + no-org alert; members loading/error/empty; rows show name/email/role.

user_story: As an owner/admin, I want to create a claim link for an email+role, so that I add teammates.
expected_behaviour: Invite card only for owner/admin (member sees no card, no explanatory copy); role Member/Admin only; success reveals claim link; 403 + generic errors (good).

user_story: As an owner/admin, I want to copy the claim URL, so that I hand it to the invitee.
expected_behaviour: Copy → 'Copied' (never resets); clipboard rejection unhandled (silent).
error_detail: Copy invite link: clipboard rejection unhandled; "Copied" never resets
fix_summary: Clipboard write try/catch + error toast + 'Copied' resets after 1.5s

user_story: As a project member, I want to see all working notes, so that I find scratch context I saved earlier.
expected_behaviour: Loading/error/not-found/empty ('No notes yet. Create one…') all present; cards show title + stripped preview + relative time.

user_story: As a member, I want to create a titled note, so that I start capturing findings.
expected_behaviour: Dialog with title (autofocus); empty blocked; 'Creating…'; inline error on failure; success toast + navigate to new note (good).

user_story: As a member, I want to read a note and switch to editing, so that I revise in place.
expected_behaviour: Reader/Edit tabs; empty note auto-opens Edit; save error alert; Delete button only rendered in Edit mode (hidden affordance for a reader who wants to delete).
error_detail: Delete button only rendered in Edit mode; a reader cannot delete

user_story: As a member, I want edits saved automatically, so that I don't lose work or click Save.
expected_behaviour: 1s debounce/5s maxWait, ⌘S + unmount + tab-close flush; status pill Saved/Unsaved/Saving/retry (good).

user_story: As a member, I want to delete a note with a safeguard, so that I don't remove it by accident.
expected_behaviour: Confirm dialog (note+comments deleted, cannot be undone); busy state; success toast + navigate (good).

user_story: As an owner, I want a public read-only link to a task, so that an outside agent/person reads it as Markdown.
expected_behaviour: Share dialog; TTL 24h/7d/Never; 'Creating…'; on failure only a transient toast (no persistent/inline error, no retry); success shows URL + expiry; 'agent-ready Markdown' is jargon.
error_detail: Share-create failure is a transient toast only; no persistent/inline error or retry

user_story: As an owner, I want a public read-only link to a document, so that I share a spec externally.
expected_behaviour: Same ShareButton kind=document; but Share is only visible in the doc's Edit mode — a reader can't share.
error_detail: Doc Share only visible in Edit mode; a reader cannot share

user_story: As an owner, I want to copy the minted link, so that I paste it to a recipient.
expected_behaviour: Copy + toast + 1.5s check; read-only URL auto-selects; BUT it copies markdown_url (the .md URL) not the human-friendly result.url, which may confuse a recipient expecting a normal page.
error_detail: Copy copies markdown_url (.md) not human result.url
fix_summary: Copy now uses the human page URL (result.url) not the .md url

user_story: As a member, I want a comments panel beside content, so that I leave/read feedback for a teammate or agent.
expected_behaviour: Header 'Comments · N open'; loading/error/empty; open always shown, resolved collapsible; sanitized HTML bodies; wired on docs + notes.

user_story: As a reviewer, I want a formatted comment with images, so that my feedback is clear.
expected_behaviour: Rich composer; Comment disabled unless content; success toast + clear; inline error on failure (good).

user_story: As a reviewer, I want to quote the exact text, so that context is unambiguous.
expected_behaviour: 'Attach selection' captures a quoted chip; if nothing is selected the button silently no-ops with no feedback telling the user to select text first.
error_detail: "Attach selection" silently no-ops when nothing selected

user_story: As a reader, I want to select text and comment right there, so that I don't lose my place.
expected_behaviour: Selecting text surfaces a floating 'Add comment' → anchored composer with a tracking highlight; ⌘Enter submits; appears only on selection (tacit) and only on docs/notes, not the task drawer.

user_story: As a member, I want to mark feedback resolved, so that the open count reflects outstanding work.
expected_behaviour: Per-comment resolve/reopen with pending state; success toast; resolved move to collapsible muted section (good).

user_story: As a member, I want to delete a comment safely, so that I remove mistakes.
expected_behaviour: Confirm dialog (cannot be undone); busy state; success toast (good).

user_story: As a board user, I want to comment on a task, so that I discuss it with a teammate/agent where I work.
expected_behaviour: A real user expects to comment on a task from the board; the TaskDrawer renders NO comments rail, so task comments are only reachable via the canvas detail panel or MCP — an inconsistency with docs/notes.
error_detail: Task drawer has no comments rail; task comments unreachable from board

user_story: As an author, I want to add images by button/paste/drop, so that I illustrate content.
expected_behaviour: Hosted upload to /api/v1/files with lean URL; on failure or no project it silently falls back to inline base64 (user never told it wasn't hosted); no upload progress/spinner; toolbar uses hardcoded hex (no dark-mode).
error_detail: Image upload has no progress indicator; toolbar hardcoded hex (no dark mode)

user_story: As a reviewer, I want to draw arrows/boxes/labels on an image, so that I point precisely.
expected_behaviour: Hover→Annotate; SVG overlay + tools + color + undo + done; round-trips as re-editable JSON; Annotate only appears on hover (tacit affordance).
error_detail: Annotate only appears on hover

user_story: As a reviewer, I want to permanently blur sensitive parts before sharing, so that I don't leak data to the portal.
expected_behaviour: Blur baked into the persisted original on Done (un-redacted pixels never stored); irreversible with no confirm/warning that Done makes redaction permanent.
error_detail: Blur redaction is permanent on Done with no confirm/warning
fix_summary: Blur redaction confirms permanence before baking
